name: Dumbbell Bench Press

instructions.description: Lie on a bench with feet supported and dumbbells near the chest.
Set the shoulders comfortably against the bench.
Press the dumbbells upward without colliding them.
Lower them under control until the upper arms reach a comfortable depth.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Dumbbell Bench Press — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Dumbbell Bench Press — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Use a spotter or lighter loads when appropriate.
